147:t_1:178.en:
$$千葉$$
「We've received a report of an enemy attack...!」

147:t_1:179.en:
$$玉城$$
「Damn it! They're attacking $$トウキョウ$$ at a time like this?!」

147:t_1:181.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「I know. They are probably coordinating with the person who can amplify hatred.」

147:t_1:183.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「The enemy will launch an all-out attack...! Concentrate the forces from every front in $$トウキョウ$$!」

147:t_1:184.en:
$$藤堂$$
「If we don't win this battle, $$新日本$$ has no future...! We'll meet the enemy with everything we have!」

147:t_1:186.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「...I am $$ゼロ$$... the man who works miracles.」

147:t_1:187.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「And they will pay for making me use $$ギアス$$ again!」

147:t_2:4.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Is this... the inside of $n's mind...?!」

147:t_2:7.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Give yourself over to hatred, $n. Then you will feel better.」

147:t_2:9.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Stay strong, $n...! Hatred and the feelings opposing it are fighting inside you now!」

147:t_2:10.en:
$$スズネ$$
「If you overcome the hatred, you'll...!」

147:t_2:13.en:
$$スズネ$$
「No, I won't be quiet. I have the right to speak too.」

147:t_2:14.en:
$n
「M... Mom...! No, Mom! I... I don't want to die!」

147:t_2:19.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Are $n's and Miss $$スズネ$$'s minds... mingling together...?」

147:t_3:5.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「They got us at the very end. I never imagined they were prepared to destroy their own city with their own hands...」

147:t_3:6.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「I'd be happy if $$ゼロ$$ died meeting his people's hopes or fled in defeat, his authority ruined. This outcome surprises me.」

147:t_3:8.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Given their past scars, I thought protecting the city was their highest tactical priority, but...」

147:t_3:9.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「My, my... Earthlings' mental makeup really is unusual even by galactic standards.」

147:t_3:11.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「What do you intend to do about $$新日本$$?」

147:t_3:12.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Leave it to $$ギルター$$ or someone.」

147:t_3:13.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Hmm... Today's dramatic ending raised the Japanese people's morale again. I suspect $$ギルター$$ will have a hard time...」

147:t_3:15.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「...I understand. Well... $$新日本$$ has all but fallen already, so a little more time should be no problem.」

147:t_3:17.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Rest assured. I've sent the pursuit force as arranged.」

147:t_3:18.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Those heartbroken people have it rough. Their pursuers will arrive before they have a moment's peace.」

147:t_3:19.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「If that crushes $c and that man $n, that's their limit.」

147:t_3:20.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Then shall we return to the imperial capital, $$ラース・バビロン$$?」

147:t_3:21.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「'Remember this,' was it...? Heh... What cheap words.」

147:t_3:22.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「$c, $n... Don't think such shallow hatred can defeat me.」

147:t_3:27.en:
$$アムロ$$
「...I see. So you came down to Earth to collect the missing $$νガンダム$$, $$チェーン$$.」

147:t_3:28.en:
$$チェーン$$
「But the Federation troops at that base were already colluding with $$サイデリアル$$, and they took me prisoner.」

147:t_3:29.en:
$$アムロ$$
「They didn't mistreat you, did they?」

147:t_3:30.en:
$$チェーン$$
「I'm all right. They apparently wanted me to perform maintenance on the $$νガンダム$$.」

147:t_3:31.en:
$$アムロ$$
「What did they need it for?」

147:t_3:32.en:
$$チェーン$$
「...I don't know. They may have meant to use it themselves, but I doubt many pilots could handle it properly.」

147:t_3:33.en:
$$チェーン$$
「From what I overheard, they said something about sending it to $$オーガスタ$$, but...」

147:t_3:34.en:
$$アムロ$$
「So it's the $$ニュータイプ$$ Research Institute... They may have meant to use the $$νガンダム$$ for a new $$強化人間$$...」

147:t_3:35.en:
$$チェーン$$
「After that, $$ソレスタルビーイング$$ rescued me, and I stayed aboard the $$プトレマイオス$$.」

147:t_3:36.en:
$$チェーン$$
「Then I took part in the operation to capture $$セントラル・ベース$$, but...」

147:t_3:37.en:
$$アムロ$$
「So that man... $$バルビエル$$ defeated you...」

147:t_3:39.en:
$$アムロ$$
「His power may be even greater than $$ガドライト#pilot$$'s, whom we fought in the $$時獄戦役$$...」

147:t_3:40.en:
$$アムロ$$
「With resupply so difficult, even $$ソレスタルビーイング$$ must have struggled to face him.」

147:t_3:42.en:
$$タクヤ$$
「Captain $$アムロ$$! They say a $$サイデリアル$$ force is closing in on us!」

147:t_3:43.en:
$$ミコット$$
「All members of the mobile force have been ordered to prepare for launch!」

147:t_3:46.en:
$$アムロ$$
「If they're targeting us, that's convenient. We'll keep moving and throw them into confusion.」

147:t_3:48.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Either way, we can't avoid fighting that man $$バルビエル$$. He seems to be targeting $n.」

147:t_3:49.en:
$$アムロ$$
(But what I sensed in $n's heart then... What was that...?)

147:t_3:50.en:
$$アムロ$$
(Those dark emotions... Is something like that lying dormant within $n...?)

147:t_3:51.en:
$$アムロ$$
(And then there's Miss $$スズネ$$... What exactly is she...?)

147:t_10:4.en:
$n
「Sorry, $$ＡＧ$$. $$サイデリアル$$ is here. If you want to talk, make it later.」

147:t_10:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...The $$怨嗟の魔蠍$$, $$バルビエル・ザ・ニードル$$... The appearance of a new $$リアクター$$ seems to concern you.」

147:t_10:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But $$バルビエル$$ seems to feel the same. He showed considerable interest in the $$いがみ合う双子$$' $$スフィア$$.」

147:t_10:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I'll add the 50 Z worth of $$Ｚチップ$$s generated when $n fought him to the team's stock.」
